# GitHub Copilot Instructions

**This file delegates to [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) as the single source of truth for all repository rules.**

Always read and follow `AGENTS.md` at the repo root. That file contains:

- Project structure, entry points, and configuration
- Coding conventions and Hono + React Router integration patterns
- Repository rules (package management, styling, CLI tools, verification)
- Default workflow (inspect → edit → verify → probe)

Do not duplicate rules here. If you need to know how this repo works, read `AGENTS.md` first.
